title: Mechanics directive tokenization

implementation_steps: Add MECHANICS_KWD token type to scanner enum
Implement scanner rule to recognize '% mechanics' prefix
Tokenize directive keywords (dim, coord, material, formulation, cell, boundary)
Write lexer unit tests for expected token streams

cases: Token stream for material directive with arguments
